notes.title: Rhythm Bang v1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
- [b]Mapping[/b]: Flash colors can now be adjusted to #FFFFFF
- [b]Song select:[/b] Fixed local highscore not hiding when it doesn't exist on custom maps
- [b]Gameplay:[/b] Fixed a bug where flash events wouldn't play after you died with no fail on
- [b]Mapping:[/b] Fixed a power of 0 on cubes not being instant spawing
- [b]Mapping:[/b] Fixed the jank when using shift to select multiple consecutive cubes
- [b]Song select:[/b] Reduced the amount of rendered songs from 20 to 12 as only 10 could be seen anyway
[h1]Changes[/h1]
- [b]Pause menu:[/b] Added volume slider
- [b]Mapping:[/b] Added auto play
- [b]Mapping:[/b] Added bounds for top parameter on all types
- [b]Modifiers:[/b] Removed 'Manual' modifier as it does not align with the game's vision
- [b]Auto play:[/b] Disable score pop up
- [b]Mapping:[/b] Added save and exit button
